decisions.title: One human-requested integration PR
decisions.decision: Convert every embedded PR sequence to ordered internal work packets/commits. Finish existing355 lifecycle first. A planning PR is not the full implemented or scientifically qualified system.

decisions.title: Existing authority and source pin
decisions.decision: Read actual current code and AGENTS; preserve dirty canonical797f and private310 notes.8fc is a dated planning pin; revalidate against receiving main.

decisions.title: Existing updates versus closure
decisions.decision: Do not describe all learning as zero-update. Historical optimizer updates, fresh-loop closure, benefit at discovery, serving adoption and sustained improvement are separate proof obligations.

decisions.title: Development discovery scoreboard
decisions.decision: Add exact best-of-B/AUC only with declared law/support/cost. L6 can remain stability diagnostic. Do not retroactively rejudge previous confirmatory decisions or erase negative outcomes.

decisions.title: Changing F10 or sealed-family authority
decisions.decision: S1 changes endpoint/contexts while saying F10 unchanged; S5/S6 require adopted roster. Existing accepted F10 remains; a new discovery protocol needs prospective ADR, exposure boundary, independent issuer and look budget.

decisions.title: One existing native trainer
decisions.decision: Reuse jope-parallel native trainer/coordinator/checkpoint/consumption. Preserve original GPU dispatch hold. No fourth trainer, second scheduler, silent Python exception or moment fabrication.

decisions.title: Ancestry versus numeric step
decisions.decision: A legitimate epoch3000 descendant may be a challenger; random70000 is not. Version new export/lineage path without weakening exact accepted release checks.

decisions.title: Strategy versus vocabulary
decisions.decision: Existing SearchProfile is vocabulary; new SearchStrategy is algorithm. Preserve two orthogonal IDs and inject learning/store adapters to avoid dependency cycle.

decisions.title: Conflicting modern-GP defaults
decisions.decision: S1 proposes8x16islands; S6 steady-state16-64aging; S4/S5 common controller. Preserve as candidate profiles with component ablations; no universal new default or claimed benefit.

decisions.title: Typed additive semantics and generated registry
decisions.decision: Preserve stable IDs/frozen RNG arrays and old grammar bytes. Distinguish lag dialects, strict parameters for new versions, nested fit effects and numeric identity changes.

decisions.title: Exact arena conditions
decisions.decision: F(x)^B requires IID replacement draws from fixed fully measured law.95percent support does not make full-policy result exact. Conditional/partial/adaptive results have explicit different labels/estimands.

decisions.title: Behavior probability
decisions.decision: Thompson posterior samples are not action propensities. Continuous density and discrete probability differ. GP ancestry is not its seed density; unknown behavior law excludes unbiased PG/OPE claims.

decisions.title: Fingerprint similarity
decisions.decision: Finite probe agreement does not justify copying full measured outcomes or proving semantic equivalence. Use advisory novelty/screening until a valid equivalence proof.

decisions.title: Native critic, v3 family and KernelNet
decisions.decision: S1 Kumo2051/open401 and S6 native2048columnKernelNet are incompatible proposals. First close existing native lineage; critic-only candidate first; architecture/context migration is explicit independent experiment.

decisions.title: Objectives and schedules
decisions.decision: AWR/PKPO/HLGauss/quantile/EMA/WSD/cosine/shrinkperturb are ablation proposals with conflicting coefficients. Preserve current controls and objective IDs; freeze only after eligibility/parity review.

decisions.title: No exposure laundering
decisions.decision: Reject historical test_adaptive representation pretraining by default despite S1 suggestion. Any later reuse needs governed role revision and independent future qualification boundary; no old claim upgrade.

decisions.title: Existing CAS and credentials
decisions.decision: Conditional writes and credential_process already exist. Fix exact verified remaining content/refresh gaps, not a duplicate store or stale IMDS diagnosis. Live IAM/S3 operations remain separately admitted.

decisions.title: One authority namespace and derived lake
decisions.decision: Use research/v2 design namespace; lake/outcome tables are derived role-filtered views. Do not promote staging or infer current estate from September inventory. Final installed prefix needs owner decision.

decisions.title: Adaptive thinning unbiasedness
decisions.decision: S6 adaptive surprise with reused deterministic u does not establish known marginal inclusion pi. HT totals differ from ratio means; repeated adaptive designs require full selection-history proof. Start fixed bounded replay; no automatic unbiasedness claim.

decisions.title: Expiry and cleanup
decisions.decision: No blanket30day noncurrent expiry, tensor expiry or signed-plan-only bypass of live pins. Exact physical versions, recovery obligations, publisher fencing, independent restoration and separate execution admission are required. Never delete symlink folders.

decisions.title: Memory truth
decisions.decision: CI containing0 is inconclusive unless an equivalence design establishes a null. Do not automatically pool correlated/adaptively selected experiments into qualified beliefs. Memory is derived; unknowns/nulls and limitations survive.

decisions.title: Deep MCTS, league and code evolution
decisions.decision: Root search only after measured teacher review; deeper search after calibrated value and matched wins. League2/3/5member thresholds conflict: require actual accepted competitive policies and evidence of need. Generated code cannot edit scientific kernel.

decisions.title: Conservative maintainability
decisions.decision: No compulsory wholesale history moves, source deletion, Python archive or campaign split on critical path. Preserve locks, held consumers and source-byte evaluator identities. Generated concise state is additive first.

decisions.title: Honest progress and review identity
decisions.decision: Plan indexing, semantic review, source implementation, fixture proof, CI, live execution, science and serving have separate percentages/states. Grok402 is blocked; real contributions/identity needed, process names are insufficient.

decisions.title: Per-version/wave detailed data plus compact Git context
decisions.decision: Every wave including failure saves detailed compressed training/outcome evidence and a deterministic compact Git manifest/context. Bulk evidence remains in verified content-addressed state/mirror storage; Git carries schemas, compact facts, evidence roots and tiny fixtures. Optimize measured information/byte, never erase scientific detail or retention obligations.

decisions.title: Competing discovery endpoints and calculators
decisions.decision: S4 terminal regularized log-MSE, S5 selected-artifact log-RMSE AUC on log-budget, and S1 linear-budget q-AUC/best-of-B differ. Freeze one prospective primary/margin/cost/alpha contract before outcomes; others remain named diagnostics. Reuse qualify::promotion::decide and its exact SplitMix64/type1 quantile convention rather than silently mixing context-weighted bootstrap calculators.

decisions.title: Native fixture feature gates and zero-test trap
decisions.decision: Current objective_fixtures, continuation_modes, checkpoint_commit and committed_updates are cfg(neural). Explicit --features neural plus supported LibTorch are required to collect them; default-feature CI success is not their coverage. Native_loop_continuation is a distinct CPU/default protocol test.

decisions.title: Witness epoch compatibility is part of successor design
decisions.decision: Claude located eval_registry/witness/epochs.rs numeric-step window restriction. Versioned successor design must cover witness window rules as well as native_loop and challenger loader; it cannot just lower a step threshold or release original numerical/adoption holds.

decisions.title: One state/claim vocabulary; historical partial waves
decisions.decision: Use proposed versioned round-event states with distinct research/serving decisions and capsule-publication-pending state. Do not reuse L6 as claim-level name. Archive truncated/aborted historical waves only as HISTORICAL_PARTIAL from admitted retained evidence, with missing prefixes/admission/stop-label caveats. No protected-history rescan or synthetic field reconstruction.

decisions.title: Disclosure-filter Git context and resolve real content identities
decisions.decision: Git is an export boundary: role/disclosure policy applies to compact context and aggregate metrics too. Do not publish sealed family IDs, targets, protected feedback, private rows or secrets by summarizing them. Pin source content/custody object hashes and physical versions rather than a scratch symlink path; never delete that symlink or probe protected old assets to fill gaps.
